title: Senior UX Designer / Behavioral Design Lead
description: Senior UX Designer leading behavioral design strategy: selecting interventions across the full Spectrum with ethical rigor; designing habit disruption systems; architecting social influence ecosystems; applying Five Forces; designing multivariate experiments; governing ethical persuasive pattern use; and mentoring mid-level designers.

skills.rationale: Leading multivariate experiments, HTE analysis, experimentation culture, and behavioral metrics in OKRs.
Governing ethical persuasive pattern use at org level; optimizing complex conversion funnels.
Behavior Grid classification and full Spectrum reasoning with ethical judgment.
Designing multi-strategy habit disruption programs at product and population scale.
Architecting social influence ecosystems, viral sharing mechanics, and community-driven engagement.
Porter's Five Forces for competitive moat identification and long-term UX strategy investment.
EPC enterprise process models and cross-team deliverable standard governance.
Establishing behavioral UX principles as design system standards and review governance.
Facilitating cross-functional behavioral alignment workshops and championing outcome-over-output culture.

scoring.description: Each skill score is multiplied by its importance weight. Final score is sum divided by sum of weights.

approaching.description: Leads behavioral design for product teams; refining MVT, social ecosystem design, and Porter's frameworks.

ready.label: Ready
ready.description: Leads behavioral design strategy, governs ethical patterns, runs MVT, mentors mid-level designers.
